purpose: Render a professional embodied fly + whole-MaleCNS split view while preserving evidence semantics and replay provenance.

layout.scientific: embodied world left; 3D MaleCNS right; shared causal timeline bottom
layout.social: cinematic two-column world/CNS composition with minimal persistent text

connectome_geometry.whole_cns_lod: aggressively simplified line geometry; progressive loading
connectome_geometry.active_route_lod: exact or high-resolution skeletons for selected body IDs
connectome_geometry.activity_mapping: only actual modeled state/events may drive emissive intensity

visual_evidence_classes.measured_structure: neutral low-opacity whole CNS; saturated exact route
visual_evidence_classes.modeled_activity: emissive intensity / event flash on exact neuron morphology
visual_evidence_classes.behavioral_state: body pose, trajectory, local sensor state and physical odor field
visual_evidence_classes.lesion: retain geometry but desaturate / mark cut
visual_evidence_classes.rewire: render as graph/topology control, never invent rewired anatomical arbors

required_public_labels: DEVELOPMENT BEHAVIOR or QUALIFIED CONTROLLER as appropriate
forbidden_visual_implications: illustrative pulse presented as measured firing
mechanism probe presented as synchronized to an unrelated chase
rewired edges drawn as if they were biological neuron morphology
source coordinates shown inside controller-facing HUD
production_goal: A viewer should understand in under three seconds: what the fly senses, what part of the CNS is active in the model, and what action follows.
